extraction.Name: Joe St John
extraction.Cancelled: I would reconmend that he have his patent cancelled
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: took out a mtg on this land for $100 dollars
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: he got this mtg of $100.00 to pay up the taxes on this allotment; taxes are sky high in this part of the county and it is only a matter of time, that he will loose his land or be forced to sell it
extraction.Occupation/Income: good farmer and has farmed year after year, and still is willing to farm
extraction.NOTES: Document dated January 14, 1989 [likely 1929]; Joe St John tried to get his land reverted back to trust land but the mortgage clause stopped him; he still holds his land and is one of the few that kept his land; he is getting old and unable to earn as much as he used to; there has been crop failure in recent years; taxes run from $80.00 to $135.00 a year; has some small children to raise; agency writer recommends patent cancellation | TASK 5 CAT_3 BACKFILL 2026-05-04 (patents database): Allotment 547 sourced from federal-register-app patents database (Christian's research, 2026-05-04). CAT_3 record — Sonnet text extraction captured the allottee Name but not the Allotment number. TRIBE: previous label 'Big Bond District' updated to 'Crow Creek Sioux'. The extraction's tribe label 'Big Bond District' is an error for 'Big Bend District' (a district of the Crow Creek Reservation). Tribe set to Crow Creek Sioux.
